_planner_rationale: cross-family composite on one host stack: Particular rain (validated recipes/mined/rain.json core: huge world-space box emitter, Angle X -90 directional, vel 2500, thin size-2 spheres) -> ADBE Tint neon grade -> Wave Warp + Shift Channels glitch (from the validated native-chroma-glitch stack)

青+品红 — magenta lives in the BG solid [0.10,0.02,0.12] and the Tint black-map [0.09,0.01,0.13]; cyan lives in the rain streaks (white-map [0.5,0.98,0.95]) — both hues present without CC Toner's unprobed params
偶发故障 — square Wave Warp (height 5, speed 2.7) + R<->B channel crossover; the rain-on-violet base is chromatic so the swap is visible (r10 gotcha)
psec trimmed 5000->3000 and life 1.2 (screen-crossing time) to keep density heavy but readable

r2 (2026-07-19): rain read as DOTS (0524 aspect inert on Sphere) + drops were YELLOW (Shift Channels R<->B swap inverts cyan->yellow, a constant full swap not 'occasional slight glitch'). Fix: Particle Type Streaklet (0703=5) = native elongated rain streaks + shutter 300 for motion-blur length; REMOVE Shift Channels (Wave Warp square-wave animation supplies the glitch flicker between frames); bright cyan-white drops so Tint's white->cyan map gives the neon cyan grade over the magenta-violet night.

r3: Streaklet rendered short random-angle dashes. Switch to Sphere + strong GRAVITY (0017=3600, guaranteed straight-down accelerating fall) + MAX motion-blur shutter 360 + velocity 0 => long vertical rain streaks along the fall vector. Gravity (world-down) removes the direction ambiguity that made streaklets diagonal.

r4 (2026-07-19): motion blur was the missing streak lever — Particular shutter (0035/0036) only elongates drops when the COMP motion blur + layer motion-blur switch are ON (new runner field motionBlur:true). Rain now streaks. Gentled Wave Warp (height 5->1.5, width 22->70) so it's a subtle glitch wobble not tight squiggles; velocity 3000 + opacity 100 for brighter streaks; bright cyan drops -> neon grade.

r5: 6/10 residue. (1) Wave Warp still bent rain into 'scan stripes' -> height 0.4 (near-straight rain, faint fast wobble reads as flicker not a standing wave). (2) magenta not clear -> brighten Tint Map-Black-To to visible magenta (0.22,0.02,0.28) so the night shows magenta, cyan drops vivid. (3) denser/brighter rain.

r6: magenta still too dark (near-black night) + cyan dim. Brighten Tint Map-Black-To to a clear magenta (0.32,0.04,0.4); add Glo2 after Tint to bloom the bright cyan streaks into vivid neon => both cyberpunk inks clearly present.

r7 (final): coarse 'digital noise' read = fat size-5.5 drops -> chunky segmented streaks. Thin drops (size 2.5) + very high density (8500) + velocity 3200 => fine continuous rain streaks. Magenta night brightened to 0.42,0.06,0.5 (clearly visible cyan+magenta grade).

_eval_result.note: Improved from round-1 dots+yellow (5/5/6) to dense STRAIGHT cyan rain streaks + correct cyan/magenta grade (stable 6). Breakthrough: motion blur is the streak lever — Particular shutter (0035/0036) only elongates drops when COMP + layer motion blur are ON (new runner field motionBlur:true). Residual (uncrossed): Particular renders DISCRETE particles so motion-blur streaks read as segmented/dashed, not continuous high-speed rain lines (fundamental limitation; Streaklet gave short scattered dashes); magenta presence limited by the dark duotone; glitch legibility in 2 stills is weak. GPT scorer also intermittently reports seeing only t1, sinking the between-frame glitch criterion.
